title: Source who has been inside S4

tellings.quote: I've actually I've I've talked to one person who has been to S4

plain: S4 is said to be a secret site near Papoose Lake in Nevada, close to the base known as Area 51. A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says he has talked with one person who has been inside S4. He does not name that person or say what they saw, but if true it would mean the site is real and people have worked there.
